description: Use this when someone asks what to publish or write, for content or blog ideas, or how to show up in Google or AI answers: lists the articles and short answers GatherHQ suggests for the workspace, each from a question its buyers raise in real interviews, with how many raised it, searches a month, where the site ranks on Google, which AI answers cite it or others, buyers' own words, and a brief (what to open with, sections, searches, where it goes). Each article has a suggestion_id for gather_draft_article. It writes nothing: do not use it to write copy, headlines or posts.
name: gather_what_to_publish
title: What to publish
